name: Koh Lanta
tagline: Laid-back beaches and the Four Islands
summary: Koh Lanta is the relaxed, family-friendly island of the Andaman coast, with long sunset beaches down its west side. Take a longtail to the Four Islands and the Emerald Cave, snorkel at Koh Rok, see the lighthouse at Mu Ko Lanta National Park and wander the stilt-house Old Town on the east coast.
seasonNote: November to April is dry; in the monsoon (May to October) many resorts close and boats stop.
arrival: Minivan and car ferries from Krabi (about 2.5 hours); boats from Phi Phi and Krabi in high season.
gettingAround: Rent a scooter or use tuk-tuks.
cashTip: Carry baht for street food, tuk-tuks and boats; cards work in hotels and malls. Tipping is small and optional.
foodTip: Massaman curry, fresh seafood barbecues on the beach and southern Thai curries.
buyTip: Batik and local crafts in the Old Town.
